name: @post/e2e-conflicts
description: Scientific Conflict Resolution UI e2e (T0407 required test): real Chromium drives the built web app through the Conflicts page — three-way base/A/B values, per-side evidence context, the advisory-only detector explanation (仅建议), exactly five explicit decision options, the CSRF-carrying save, and the absence of any averaged/auto-applied value. The API is mocked at the network layer with the exact wire shapes cmd/api/conflicthttp produces/consumes (the Go handler suite locks those shapes against a real guard).
